name: Whiteboard
description: A collaborative drawing canvas with live cursors of everyone on the board.
headline: What should we *sketch*?
intro: The whiteboard is open on the right. The agent can draw strokes on it through its API, or add tools like shapes, colors and text.

suggestions.p: Draw a simple architecture diagram on this board: a client, an API and a database, connected by arrows.
Add a color palette and a stroke-width picker to this whiteboard.
Add rectangle, arrow and text tools to this whiteboard.
Add a button that exports this board as a PNG download.
